text:
maya: Nightly eval (q4-llama2-q8b) shows ~12% invoke failures on tool calls. Logs indicate the top-level args is sometimes a JSON-encoded string instead of an array/object. Example payload we pulled from logs: ```{"tool":"kb.search","args":"[\"redwood\",\"inference\"]"}```
omar: Ugh, that's that stringification-on-emit bug again. Is this limited to quantized variants? :thinking_face:
maya: Mostly hit on q8b/q4 experiments in the quant bring-up runs, but there was one fp16 run that showed the same pattern. Seems correlated with streaming chunk joins and the tokenizer edge-case where quotes get injected.
jun: Can you paste the stack trace snippet?
maya: Short form: ```ValueError: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes: line 1 column 2 (char 1) at json.loads(args)```
zhen: That matches a double-parse failure: runtime sees args as a string, calls json.loads once (gets a string) then downstream code calls json.loads again and explodes.
omar: Can you repro locally quickly?
maya: Yep, repro in nightly harness: `pytest tests/nightly/test_invoke_args.py::test_blobbed_args -k q8 --runslow` fails consistently.
eng-ci-bot: CI: nightly/test_invoke_args.py failed on q8b-quant build (job id 4523) :warning:
jun: Hypothesis: model emitted a quoted JSON chunk. Quick mitigation: add a pre-parse guard in the serving runtime: if isinstance(args, str): try json.loads(args) and accept it, otherwise raise a clear FncallSchemaError.
zhen: Agree. Also add a schema validation layer in the tool-adapter so we can reject stringified arrays early and log a sampled model output for debugging. Patch plan: 1) hotfix in serving runtime parse logic, 2) backfill adapter scrubber + unit tests, 3) add nightly eval assertion to detect recurrence.
omar: Hotfix path looks low-risk. Serving runtime change first for immediate mitigation; adapter scrubber follow-up. Also add a small integration test that simulates model emitting quoted JSON.
maya: I'll open the PR and include unit+integration tests, plus update nightly eval threshold to fail if >1% schema mismatch. Filing now.
jun: Also add a golden prompt to the eval set that contains nested arrays/objects — that'll catch regressions where tokenization injects quotes.
zhen: And create a Grafana alert for fncall_schema_errors by model variant so we detect model-specific regressions quickly.
maya: Filing incident + PR links: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/7821 and https://boards.redwood.com/INC-2026-082
omar: Nice. Anything else? :thumbsup:
maya: Payload sample we saw in raw logs for reference: ```{"tool":"kb.search","args":"[{\"q\":\"redwood inference\",\"top_k\":3}]"}```
jun: I'll add an integration test that simulates the model outputting quoted JSON with escaped quotes, and assert our guard normalizes it.
eng-ci-bot: Noted. Scheduling rollback hooks if the patch causes regressions.
maya: Will monitor tomorrow's nightly run and post results here :eyes:
omar: Thanks — please ping if the failure rate doesn't drop below 1% after the patch.
